### `json` matcher

Deep JSON equality, value is a STRING containing JSON text (not a JSON object literal). Non-string or invalid-JSON never matches. https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/matching/matchers.html

**Value type:** `string`
**Config:** not supported.
**doMatch:** AND-semantics — re-tests the same input against the next matcher.
